name: Sugano Fuu
source:
Tsukiyado High 1st Year, Class 4.
Member of the broadcasting club.

A person with common sense who doesn't get carried away.
However, she has slightly different sensibilities. Her tone is always weakly polite (and somewhat samurai-like?).
She's very athletic, and if anything, she's probably (maybe) more popular with girls than boys.
People often say, "You have a cute face, but there's something disappointing about it.''

[Translated from the [url=http://www.takuyo.co.jp/products/kaerubatake/char_huu.html]official website[/url].]
